policy.fleet_scope: all recoverable vehicles, not one-at-a-time hero work

source_fusion.rule: Search and exploit both Beta1 and Beta2 for every active vehicle. Choose the strongest legally usable body, interior, wheels, tyres, lights, glass, materials, textures, rigging, damage parts and LOD source from either library; combine complementary components when provenance and fit are valid. Do not stop after finding one usable source in one beta.
beta1_roles: CarX Highway and Gangstar vehicle candidates where recovered and verified
beta2_roles: Real Racing 3 vehicle/LOD/material/audio reference and recoverable source where authorized
other Beta2 vehicle-support assets when provenance is verified
source_fusion.promotion_gate: No active vehicle is production-complete until both Beta1 and Beta2 have been searched for that vehicle/component family and the selected cross-library source set is recorded.

crown007.rule: Crown007 is in a good accepted state and is the current quality reference. Do not treat it as permanently finished. Do not spend the main vehicle-production budget polishing it while other cars are missing. Apply shared material, LOD, wheel, damage, memory or pipeline improvements when they materially benefit Crown without displacing fleet expansion.

porsche.rule: Do not recover, reproduce, badge, brand, or increase Porsche/992 fidelity. Keep Porsche source media excluded unless owner rights status changes.

vehicles.remaining_work_policy: Keep current accepted state stable. Permit opportunistic/shared-fleet improvements, later LOD/material/wheel/damage/performance refinement, and regression fixes. Do not hold back production of the rest of the roster for Crown polish.

beta1.material_recovery: PaintStitches alpha/depth/normal-map behavior recovered; broader close-view cleanup remains useful

vehicles.rule: Do not relabel as Mark X. Build the final Chaser from the best compatible Beta1+Beta2 component set, then author missing LODs.

beta1.warning: Toyota Mark 2 and Toyota Chaser V are distinct vehicles and are not Mark X substitutes.

vehicles.rule: Do not promote until exact Mark X identity is verified; once found, still search the other beta for complementary parts/materials/LODs.
No Porsche source asset, branding, badge, body-faithful reproduction, or fidelity escalation in this lane.
